flags-answered.held: S1 (adopt-2002): its witness was r: The S1 record shows the refused witness is pb922_exception_object_user_word_85, an 85 program using EXCEPTION-OBJECT as a user word, widened to 2002 and refused there (COBOL2196/COBOL1694). The description of an object property used as a sending item is the same as the description of the returning item of the get property method.
If the GET phrase is specified, then the method shall have no USING phrase parameters specified in the procedure division header and shall have a single RETURNING phrase.
If the SET phrase is specified, then the method shall have a single USING parameter specified in the procedure division header and no RETURNING phrase.

The ACTIVE-CLASS phrase may be specified only in a factory definition, an instance definition, or the linkage or local-storage section of a method definition.
